tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the tools in the claw.mobile catalogue (33 AI app builders, AI IDEs, terminal agents and coding assistants) with plans, prices and price provenance. Optional filters: type and free (true = only tools with a free plan, false = only tools without one). Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/too

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full record for one tool by slug (e.g. "cursor", "lovable", "claude-code"): plans, prices, features, pros, cons, rating (null if unrated), price source, vendor website and claw.mobile page. Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/{slug}.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 or 3 tools by slug: price, type, best-for, skill level, rating and free tier differences, plus a rule-based verdict. Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/compare.

tools.name: tool_pricing
tools.description: Every tool’s starting price and plans, cheapest first, each with priceSource, priceVerifiedAt and priceSourceUrl (the vendor pricing page it was read from). Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/pricing.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Match a plain-language need (e.g. "cheapest AI app builder with a free plan", "terminal coding agent under $25") to tools in the catalogue. How it ranks: Keyword match over the catalogue, no model involved. 1) Words in the request set filters: "app builder"/"no-code"/"no code" -> type App Builder; "
